title: Several UK consultants have left large firms to start AI consultancy startups, as growth in the country's AI consulting sector outpaces the broader market (Nick Huber/Financial Times)
summary: Nick Huber / Financial Times: Several UK consultants have left large firms to start AI consultancy startups, as growth in the country's AI consulting sector outpaces the broader market — A number of consultants have left big firms to create their own software companies to automate common and repetitive work
